tasks.label: SvelteKit: dev
tasks.command: if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 24; fi; exec node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js dev --host 127.0.0.1

windows.command: $nodeCommand = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $nodeDir = if ($nodeCommand) { Split-Path $nodeCommand.Source } else { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\node-v24.18.0-win-x64' }; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe') ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js dev --host 127.0.0.1
